top_signals.title: India Says US Trade Deal Nearly Ready, Signing May Take Time
top_signals.summary: India and the US could conclude negotiations on a trade deal soon, though signing and implementing it may take longer, Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said Wednesday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Trump’s CFTC picks face Senate scrutiny as prediction market turf war heats up
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump’s nominees to the CFTC revealed how they view the hotly contested issue of how to regulate sports betting.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ex-Longview Manager to Bet on Handful of Stocks in New Fund
top_signals.summary: Katie Moran has an unconventional metric for equity selection at her boutique hedge fund: the few stocks making the grade will have passed a test of their “element of delight.”

top_signals.title: California fines Hertz $1.5 million for breaking state data privacy law
top_signals.summary: Hertz agreed to the fine and said it would change its business practices, according to a court filing shared by the regulator, the California Privacy Protection Agency (CPPA).
